title: Lions & Legends of Gujarat
shortDescription: Gujarat, located on the western coast of India, is a vibrant state known for its rich cultural heritage, spiritual significance, diverse landscapes, and historical landmarks.
description: Gujarat, located on the western coast of India, is a vibrant state known for its rich cultural heritage, spiritual significance, diverse landscapes, and historical landmarks. From sacred pilgrimage sites like Dwarka and Somnath to the majestic Statue of Unity, Gujarat offers a unique blend of tradition, history, and modern attractions. The state is famous for its colorful festivals, traditional handicrafts, delicious cuisine, and warm hospitality.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Sasan Gir & Leisure
itinerary.description: Arrive in Sasan Gir, the gateway to the famous Gir National Park, and transfer to your wildlife resort. After check-in and some relaxation, spend your day soaking in the peaceful forest surroundings. You may explore the nearby village area or opt to visit the Devalia Interpretation Zone (optional) for a short wildlife experience. Enjoy the natural ambiance, birdwatching, and fresh air. Dinner and overnight stay at the resort.

itinerary.title: Jungle Safari & Wildlife Experience
itinerary.description: Early morning, proceed for an exciting jeep safari in Gir National Park accompanied by a trained guide. Explore the dense forests, grasslands, and riverine ecosystem while spotting wildlife such as the majestic Asiatic Lion, leopards, deer, and various bird species. Return to the resort for breakfast and relaxation. Later, visit the Crocodile Breeding Centre or enjoy a nature walk around the outskirts. Evening at leisure. Dinner and overnight stay in Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Second Safari / Nature Exploration
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you can opt for another jeep safari in Gir National Park (optional but recommended for better chances of wildlife sightings). Alternatively, enjoy birdwatching, photography, or relax within the resort premises. You can also explore nearby tribal villages to experience the local culture. Spend the day at leisure amidst nature. Dinner and overnight stay in Sasan Gir.

itinerary.title: Departure from Sasan Gir
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the resort and proceed for your onward journey, carrying unforgettable memories of your wildlife adventure in Sasan Gir.
